label: Statements
description: Turns bank and card statements (PDFs, or CSVs exported from the bank) into transactions to review.

steps.label: From email
steps.description: Downloads the PDF from a statement email the Messages pipeline recognised, and reads it like an upload.
steps.whenOff: Statement emails are recognised but their PDFs aren't downloaded or read. Uploads still are.

adapters.label: Your mailbox
adapters.description: Fetches the attachment from the mailbox the email came from.

steps.label: Read statement
steps.description: Reads the statement into rows: a PDF, or a CSV exported from your bank. Pick a reader for the files you upload.

adapters.label: GLM-OCR
adapters.description: For PDFs. A small vision model reads each page's tables; the rows come from the statement's column layout. Runs on your local Ollama.

adapters.label: Docling
adapters.description: For PDFs. Finds the table on each page and reads it with PaddleOCR, RapidOCR or EasyOCR. No AI provider needed.

adapters.label: Your AI
adapters.description: For PDFs. Sends the statement text to your AI one page at a time; it returns the rows directly.

adapters.label: Bank export
adapters.description: Reads a CSV statement exported from your bank's website: HDFC's "Delimited" for accounts, or its card statement CSV. No AI, nothing guessed. It can't read PDFs, so turn off From email when you pick it: emailed statements are PDFs.

steps.label: Fallback
steps.description: Reads the statement again another way when the rows don't add up to its balances and totals, or when it prints none to check against. Keeps whichever result checks out better.
steps.whenOff: A statement is read once; rows that don't add up are kept as they are.

adapters.label: GLM-OCR
adapters.description: For PDFs. A small vision model reads each page's tables; the rows come from the statement's column layout. Runs on your local Ollama.

adapters.label: Docling
adapters.description: For PDFs. Finds the table on each page and reads it with PaddleOCR, RapidOCR or EasyOCR. No AI provider needed.

adapters.label: Your AI
adapters.description: For PDFs. Sends the statement text to your AI one page at a time; it returns the rows directly.

steps.label: Save
steps.description: Saves the rows for you to review and match against your transactions.
